description: Webhook Persistent Delivery Queue - Create WebhookDeliveryQueue class with file-backed persistence, retry with exponential backoff, dead letter storage, and atomic file writes. Integrate with existing WebhookServer for outbound event dispatch.
steps: Create src/nexus/communication/webhook_queue.py with WebhookDeliveryQueue class containing: (a) dataclass WebhookDelivery with fields: id (str/uuid), url (str), payload (dict), headers (dict), created_at (datetime), retry_count (int, default 0), next_retry_at (datetime | None), status ('pending'|'in_flight'|'dead'), last_error (str | None), (b) __init__(self, persist_path: Path, max_retries: int = 5, dead_letter_cap: int = 100)
Implement file-backed persistence: _load() on init reads JSON file into _pending and _dead_letters lists; _save() writes both lists atomically using tempfile + os.replace
Implement enqueue(delivery: WebhookDelivery) -> None: appends to _pending, calls _save()
Implement dequeue() -> WebhookDelivery | None: returns the first pending delivery whose next_retry_at is None or <= now, removes from _pending, calls _save()
Implement ack(delivery_id: str) -> bool: removes from any in-progress tracking, calls _save(), returns True if found

Implement nack(delivery_id: str, error: str) -> None: increments retry_count, sets last_error, computes next_retry_at with exponential backoff (1*2^(retry_count-1) seconds, capped at 16s), if retry_count > max_retries moves to _dead_letters (capped at dead_letter_cap, dropping oldest), calls _save()
Implement get_dead_letters() -> list[WebhookDelivery]: returns the dead letter list
Implement get_pending_count() -> int and get_dead_letter_count() -> int for observability

Add tests in tests/test_webhook_queue.py covering: enqueue/dequeue cycle, ack removes delivery, nack increments retry and computes backoff, nack beyond max_retries moves to dead letters, dead letter cap drops oldest, persistence survives simulated restart (write, create new instance, verify state), atomic write (file not corrupted if process dies mid-write), empty file on init creates empty state
acceptance_criteria: WebhookDeliveryQueue persists state to JSON file
Dead letters: deliveries exceeding max_retries (5) moved to dead_letters
Dead letter cap (100) enforced, oldest dropped
Atomic file writes (temp + os.replace) prevent corruption
State survives restart (new instance from same file)
